statement.text:
A skew brace is a set B equipped with two operations + and · such that (B, +)
is an additively written (but not necessarily abelian) group, (B, ·) is a multiplicatively
written group, and a · (b + c) = ab − a + ac for any a, b, c ∈ B.
    Is there a finite skew brace with perfect additive group and non-perfect almost
simple multiplicative group?                                                    C. Tsang
